styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Takoyaki, okonomiyaki and a night in Dotonbori.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Osaka Castle, temples and the Kuromon market.

styles.label: Nightlife
styles.blurb: Neon streets, izakaya and late-night karaoke.

stays.why: Steps from Dotonbori nightlife and easy train links to the airport and Kyoto.
Main rail hub for day trips; big malls and food halls under the station.
Shopping arcade on your doorstep, walkable to Namba and Dotonbori.
Quieter and often cheaper; good rail links and park nearby.

food: Try takoyaki and okonomiyaki; Dotonbori has plenty of stalls and small shops.
Kuromon Ichiba market is good for grilled seafood and skewers; prices vary, check before you buy.
Kushikatsu (fried skewers) is a local specialty; the Shinsekai area is known for it.
Convenience stores and standing noodle bars are cheap and quick, often under ¥1000 a meal.
Book popular restaurants ahead or go early; many small places are cash-friendly.
more_time: Swap a city day for a day trip to Kyoto or Nara by train; check times and fares on the day.
Add a half-day at Universal Studios Japan if you like theme parks; buy tickets ahead.
Spend an evening in Shinsekai for kushikatsu and the retro atmosphere.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Dotonbori, Osaka Castle and the markets; add a night for a Kyoto or Nara day trip.

month_notes: Cold and dry; highs near 9°C, lows near 1°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still cold, highs around 10°C. Few rainy days.
Milder, highs near 14°C; more rain days, bring an umbrella.
Warm and green, highs near 23°C; some rain.
Warm and wetter, highs near 26°C with more rainy days.
Hot and humid, highs near 30°C; stay hydrated.
Hottest month, highs near 32°C; plan indoor breaks.
Still warm, highs near 29°C; rain days stay high.
Cooler, highs near 17°C; good for walking.
Cold again, highs near 11°C; pack layers.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold, fairly dry winters and hot, humid, rainy summers.

items.title: Best time: spring and autumn
items.text: April, May and October bring mild highs around 19–23°C, ideal for walking and sightseeing.

items.title: Hot, humid summer
items.text: July and August reach highs near 30–32°C with many rain days. Take indoor breaks and carry water.

items.title: Rainy spells
items.text: June and September have the most rain days. Keep an umbrella and a backup indoor plan.

items.title: Cold, drier winter
items.text: January and February highs near 9–10°C, lows near 1°C. Few rain days; dress warmly.

items.title: Pack an umbrella
items.text: Rain days range from about 7 to 16 a month, so a compact umbrella helps year-round.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, light breathable clothes for summer, and a warm coat for winter.

transit.best: Osaka Metro and JR trains for most trips; use an IC card like ICOCA.

modes.text: Osaka Metro and JR trains cover the city; tap in with an IC card like ICOCA.
Buses are useful but less frequent than trains.
Taxis are easy to hail; Uber and GO work in Osaka.
Driving is not recommended for visitors; parking is expensive.
Walking and cycling are great in central areas; rent bikes from stations.
Ferries connect to Kansai Airport and nearby islands.
